title: CiteSieve: Generative engine optimization tracker | Braivex
excerpt: Generative engine optimization (GEO) tracker: CiteSieve asks ChatGPT, Google AI Mode, Gemini and 3 more engines daily which brands they name and cite.
content_html:
Generative engine optimization tools built on statistical evidence, not single-prompt guessing.

CiteSieve is an AI search visibility and generative engine optimization (GEO) tracker from Braivex: it shows marketing teams and agencies which brands AI answers name, and which sources they cite.

CiteSieve asks ChatGPT, Google AI Mode and Gemini the questions your customers ask, once a day, and Perplexity, Copilot and Google AI Overviews as well if you switch them on. It keeps every answer: the brands it names, in order, and the pages it cites.

Answers collected from

  • ChatGPT
  • Google AI Mode
  • Gemini
  • Perplexity
  • Copilot
  • Google AI Overviews

Try the measurement on sample data

Pick a question and the engines to ask, then run it. Move the days slider to see what daily runs add: more answers, and a narrower interval around every figure.

Interactive demo with sample data. Made-up brands.

Ask a question

Engines to ask, once a day

Each engine adds one answer a day. At least one stays on.

Read the measurement

14 days × 3 engines = 42 answers. One dot is one stored answer; a filled dot names Northwind Notes.

Share of voice

  2. Acme Docs26%

  4. Fieldbook19%

Each brand's share of all brand mentions in these answers.

14 days on 3 engines: 42 sample answers. Northwind Notes is named in 12, which is 29%, 95% interval 17% to 44%. Week on week: up 19 points, within noise. Largest share of voice: Papertrail, 35%.

Measured from stored answers. Nothing is estimated.

AI answers change from one run to the next, so a single answer proves little. CiteSieve repeats each prompt daily and tells you how much data stands behind every figure.

Read the full methodology, including its limits.

  1. Add the questions your customers ask

    Enter your brand, your competitors and the prompts that matter. CiteSieve can suggest prompts from what you sell.

  2. Each engine is asked, every day

    Every prompt runs daily on the engines you choose, as a searcher in your country would see it.

  3. Read who was named and what was cited

    Each answer is kept in full. Visibility, share of voice and sources all come with their sample size.

  • Every figure shows its sample

    Visibility is the share of answers that name you, shown with the number of answers and a 95% interval. A week-on-week change is labelled as significant or within noise.

  • The whole answer is kept

    Each run stores the full text, its SHA-256, the engine, the time, and the sources the answer cited. You can read any answer and export all of them as CSV.

  • Brands you did not list still count

    Share of voice counts every brand an answer names, including brands you did not enter. Your own brand and competitors are matched by exact text, so the count never rests on a model's guess.

  • Six engines, each measured on its own

    ChatGPT, Google AI Mode and Gemini are on from the start; Perplexity, Copilot and Google AI Overviews can be switched on. Answers are collected as a searcher in your chosen country would get them, through a third-party collection service, and every figure can be split by engine. An engine that gives no answer for a prompt is not counted and not charged.

  • A site audit with concrete fixes

    CiteSieve fetches your robots.txt, llms.txt, structured data, title and description, and says exactly what to change.

Pay for the answers you collect.

One credit is one answer from one engine, with its analysis. A prompt tracked daily on three engines uses about 90 credits a month. A failed run, or an engine that gives no answer, costs nothing.

Start with 70 free credits for 14 days. No card needed.

Scroll sideways to see all 5 plans.

Prices are in US dollars. They are as of 2026-11-12 and are refreshed from Braivex billing when this page loads. Payments are handled by Dodo Payments, the merchant of record; tax is added at checkout where it applies. See every plan in one table, or read how credits work.

What is generative engine optimization (GEO)?

Generative engine optimization (GEO), also called answer engine optimization (AEO), is the work of getting a brand named and its pages cited in answers written by AI search engines such as ChatGPT, Google AI Mode and Gemini. Google treats it as part of SEO. CiteSieve measures the result: how often AI answers name you, and which sources they cite.

What does CiteSieve measure?

For each question you track, CiteSieve records which brands an AI answer names, in what order, and which pages it cites. Visibility is the share of answers that name you, shown with the number of answers behind it and a 95% interval.

Which AI engines does CiteSieve collect answers from?

ChatGPT, Google AI Mode and Gemini are on from the start. Perplexity, Copilot and Google AI Overviews can be switched on. Every figure can be split by engine.

How often are answers collected?

Once a day for every active prompt, on every engine you have switched on. You can also run a prompt by hand: manual runs follow your plan's answers a day, on top of the daily collection, and the count resets at 00:00 UTC.

What is a credit?

One credit is one answer from one engine, with its analysis. A prompt tracked daily on three engines uses about 90 credits a month. An engine that gives no answer is not charged.

How are credits added, and do they roll over?

Your plan adds its credits when it starts and again at each renewal. Plan credits you have not used do not roll over to the next month. Top-up packs last 365 days. The credits that expire soonest are spent first, so plan credits go before top-up credits. If an action fails, its credits are returned automatically.

Full guide: how Braivex credits work

Is there a free trial?

The free trial gives you 70 credits for 14 days, with no card needed. You sign in with a Braivex account.

How does the free report work, and how long does it take?

You enter your brand, your website, what you sell and an email address. A site audit appears on the page within seconds. Two questions are then asked on ChatGPT and Google AI Mode, and the detailed report is emailed to you, usually 2 to 10 minutes. No account is needed.

What data does CiteSieve keep?

Each answer is stored in full with its SHA-256, the engine, the time and the sources it cited, and you can export all of them as CSV. Free-report records are deleted after 30 days. To have your data deleted, write to support@braivex.com.

Is there an API or an MCP server?

Yes, both read-only. Claude (claude.ai, Desktop or mobile) connects to the CiteSieve MCP server at /mcp by signing in: add it as a custom connector and allow access, with no key to copy. Claude Code can sign in too. For the API, or an AI assistant that cannot sign in, create an API key in Settings and send it as a bearer token to read your figures, prompts, stored answers, competitors, sources and gaps. Neither can change anything or see billing.

content_html_zh:
Generative engine optimization tools built on statistical evidence, not single-prompt guessing.

CiteSieve is an AI search visibility and generative engine optimization (GEO) tracker from Braivex: it shows marketing teams and agencies which brands AI answers name, and which sources they cite.

CiteSieve asks ChatGPT, Google AI Mode and Gemini the questions your customers ask, once a day, and Perplexity, Copilot and Google AI Overviews as well if you switch them on. It keeps every answer: the brands it names, in order, and the pages it cites.

Answers collected from

  • 聊天GPT
  • Google AI Mode
  • 双子座
  • 困惑
  • 副驾驶
  • Google AI Overviews

Try the measurement on sample data

Pick a question and the engines to ask, then run it. Move the days slider to see what daily runs add: more answers, and a narrower interval around every figure.

Interactive demo with sample data. Made-up brands.

Ask a question

Engines to ask, once a day

Each engine adds one answer a day. At least one stays on.

Read the measurement

Days tracked

14 days × 3 engines = 42 answers. One dot is one stored answer; a filled dot names Northwind Notes.

Visibility of Northwind Notes

29%

Named in 12 of 42 sample answers. 95% interval 17% to 44%, 27 points wide.

Week on week

+19 points

Within noise

Last 7 days: 8 of 21. The 7 before: 4 of 21. 95% interval of the change: -8 to 43 points.

分享声音

  1. Papertrail35%
  2. Acme Docs26%
  3. Northwind Notes (the tracked brand)19%
  4. Fieldbook19%

Each brand's share of all brand mentions in these answers.

14 days on 3 engines: 42 sample answers. Northwind Notes is named in 12, which is 29%, 95% interval 17% to 44%. Week on week: up 19 points, within noise. Largest share of voice: Papertrail, 35%.

Measured from stored answers. Nothing is estimated.

AI answers change from one run to the next, so a single answer proves little. CiteSieve repeats each prompt daily and tells you how much data stands behind every figure.

Read the full methodology, including its limits.

  3. Read who was named and what was citedEach answer is kept in full. Visibility, share of voice and sources all come with their sample size.
  • Every figure shows its sampleVisibility is the share of answers that name you, shown with the number of answers and a 95% interval. A week-on-week change is labelled as significant or within noise.
  • The whole answer is keptEach run stores the full text, its SHA-256, the engine, the time, and the sources the answer cited. You can read any answer and export all of them as CSV.
  • Brands you did not list still countShare of voice counts every brand an answer names, including brands you did not enter. Your own brand and competitors are matched by exact text, so the count never rests on a model's guess.
  • Six engines, each measured on its ownChatGPT, Google AI Mode and Gemini are on from the start; Perplexity, Copilot and Google AI Overviews can be switched on. Answers are collected as a searcher in your chosen country would get them, through a third-party collection service, and every figure can be split by engine. An engine that gives no answer for a prompt is not counted and not charged.
  • A site audit with concrete fixesCiteSieve fetches your robots.txt, llms.txt, structured data, title and description, and says exactly what to change.

What is generative engine optimization (GEO)?

Generative engine optimization (GEO), also called answer engine optimization (AEO), is the work of getting a brand named and its pages cited in answers written by AI search engines such as ChatGPT, Google AI Mode and Gemini. Google treats it as part of SEO. CiteSieve measures the result: how often AI answers name you, and which sources they cite.

What does CiteSieve measure?

For each question you track, CiteSieve records which brands an AI answer names, in what order, and which pages it cites. Visibility is the share of answers that name you, shown with the number of answers behind it and a 95% interval.

Which AI engines does CiteSieve collect answers from?

ChatGPT, Google AI Mode and Gemini are on from the start. Perplexity, Copilot and Google AI Overviews can be switched on. Every figure can be split by engine.

How often are answers collected?

Once a day for every active prompt, on every engine you have switched on. You can also run a prompt by hand: manual runs follow your plan's answers a day, on top of the daily collection, and the count resets at 00:00 UTC.

What is a credit?

One credit is one answer from one engine, with its analysis. A prompt tracked daily on three engines uses about 90 credits a month. An engine that gives no answer is not charged.

How are credits added, and do they roll over?

Your plan adds its credits when it starts and again at each renewal. Plan credits you have not used do not roll over to the next month. Top-up packs last 365 days. The credits that expire soonest are spent first, so plan credits go before top-up credits. If an action fails, its credits are returned automatically.

Full guide: how Braivex credits work

Is there a free trial?

The free trial gives you 70 credits for 14 days, with no card needed. You sign in with a Braivex account.

How does the free report work, and how long does it take?

You enter your brand, your website, what you sell and an email address. A site audit appears on the page within seconds. Two questions are then asked on ChatGPT and Google AI Mode, and the detailed report is emailed to you, usually 2 to 10 minutes. No account is needed.

What data does CiteSieve keep?

Each answer is stored in full with its SHA-256, the engine, the time and the sources it cited, and you can export all of them as CSV. Free-report records are deleted after 30 days. To have your data deleted, write to support@braivex.com.

Is there an API or an MCP server?

Yes, both read-only. Claude (claude.ai, Desktop or mobile) connects to the CiteSieve MCP server at /mcp by signing in: add it as a custom connector and allow access, with no key to copy. Claude Code can sign in too. For the API, or an AI assistant that cannot sign in, create an API key in Settings and send it as a bearer token to read your figures, prompts, stored answers, competitors, sources and gaps. Neither can change anything or see billing.
